articles.title: The 194-Year-Old Tortoise With Secrets in His DNA
articles.summary: A 194-year-old giant tortoise named Jonathan has special DNA changes that may help him live so long, and scientists hope his DNA may one day help people stay healthy as they age.

articles.title: Can a Black Hole Split Apart Like a Pair of Pants?
articles.summary: New research suggests a black hole spinning near the fastest possible rate could split apart like a pair of pants, though in our universe it looks mostly impossible.

articles.title: A 2,200-Year-Old Celtic Coin Hoard Emerges in Hungary
articles.summary: Archaeologists in Hungary found more than 200 Celtic silver coins, over 2,000 years old, packed in a small pot ahead of a construction project.
